recommendation.field: Rev.3 Matrix field carried over unchanged: 18 TMAG5253BA3 sites in two 3x3 sections (16 mm west, 17 mm east), 3 MUX groups x 6
recommendation.sensor: TI TMAG5253BA3IQDMRR (X2SON-4), 3.3 V rail, no divider, EN per MUX group
recommendation.mcu: Seeed XIAO nRF52840, socketed on 2x7 2.54 mm headers (UF2/USB-C); product-path module class remains RayTac MDBT50Q (D-052)
recommendation.power: USB 5 V bench feed -> dedicated 3.3 V sensor-rail regulator (500 mA class); D-048 NiMH AA x4 accepted on the same input node via protected 2-pin header; no on-board charging
recommendation.assembly: Full JLCPCB PCBA except XIAO (hand-socketed); doubles as D-049 condition-(2) X2SON yield vehicle

pitch_coverage: One board covers both 16 mm and 17 mm pitches (two 3x3 sections), as Rev.3/Rev.4 already did; incremental cost of the second section ~9 sensors + passives + ~35 mm board width. Two single-pitch boards rejected (2x fab/assembly minimums + session confound).
rejected_alternatives: Full 21-key Wing field (not the open question; no spare MUX inputs)
CD74HC4067 MUX (single 16:1 collapses 3-channel scan regime; RON 70 ohm typ @4.5 V vs TMUX1208 9 ohm @3.3 V)
Soldered MDBT50Q-1MV2 (thin sourcing channel, SWD-only flashing, effort on the non-tested part)
Custom module carrier (extra board spin before first measurement)
Bare nRF52840 chip (RF layout + own certification risk)
Sensor rail from XIAO 3.3 V output (MCU noise couples into the measured rail)
RP2040 readout (D-050/D-052; wrong ADC - eval must characterise the nRF52840 SAADC)
check_items: Base XIAO nRF52840's own Japan construction-type certificate number not directly retrieved (Seeed bundle claims TELEC for the family; retrievable certificate No. 222-257139 names the Plus models). Must be pinned before any product relies on the XIAO form; does not block this bench board. MDBT50Q-1MV2 Telec pre-certification is confirmed.
XIAO GPIO budget is tight: 3 AIN + 3 address + 3 EN + 1 LED = 10 of 11 header GPIO; Stage 2 pin map is a named gate.
